about: How Aico reads each subscription's usage. providers: the subscriptions it tracks, in the order the Status page lists them. lookback_days: readings older than this are dropped. reading_min_interval_s: a reading of the same window with no more use is kept only this often. late_after_min: a spend row goes late when no collection refreshed it for this long (the collect job runs every 5 minutes, see packages/jobs/data/jobs.json). unknown_after_min: routing reads every provider as unknown once the last collection is older than this (a few collection periods). Paths: statusline is under XDG_STATE_HOME, sessions under HOME, key_file under the Aico data directory.
